snippet.title: Time Takers - Official Reveal Trailer | 4K
snippet.description:
Time is the currency, survival is the cost ⌛

Time is your resource to stay alive or grow your strength. Gather it, use it, and survive intense combat. No fixed roles - every match is built on your choices in Time Takers.
